_comment: Main configuration. Tool paths are auto-resolved by searching toolsPath recursively, so you normally only set toolsPath and hayabusaPath. Everything else has a sane default. Per-run overrides come from the CLI or a -ScopeConfig file (schema: config-schema.json); precedence is CLI > scope config > this file.

tools._note: toolsPath is searched recursively for MFTECmd.exe, PECmd.exe, AmcacheParser.exe, AppCompatCacheParser.exe, SrumECmd.exe, RECmd.exe (+ Kroll_Batch.reb), EvtxECmd.exe, SBECmd.exe, RBCmd.exe, LECmd.exe, JLECmd.exe. sevenZipPath is only needed for BATCH mode with non-.zip archives (.7z/.tar.gz/.rar); leave null to auto-find 7z.exe on PATH or in Program Files. Native .zip needs no 7-Zip.

detections._note: All detection inputs are OPTIONAL and additive. An empty iocFolder is fine - Sigma (via Hayabusa) still runs. sigma.allRules enables Hayabusa's deprecated/noisy/unsupported rule sets; sigma.minLevel is the minimum rule level (informational|low|medium|high|critical); sigma.buildDfirTimeline also produces the full event timeline alongside detections.
